test_cases.name: elevate_qbr_deck
test_cases.input:
Help me be more ambitious with our quarterly business review. Right now I just turn these metrics into a deck:
month,revenue,active_users,churn_pct
2026-07,412000,18300,3.1
2026-08,398000,18050,3.6
2026-09,401000,17720,4.2
assertions: Diagnoses current approach as low-altitude task execution
Proposes outcome-focused rewrite (what changed, decisions needed, or better system than a deck)
Mentions need for raw data or access
Presents the brief for confirmation before executing it

test_cases.name: deepen_churn_analysis
test_cases.input: I want a much more ambitious churn analysis. I think it's an onboarding problem. Our events table has user_id, event_name, ts, plan, and we have 14 months of history.
assertions: Suggests adversarial check against raw data or logs
Asks for statistical models or simulation rather than only tables
Names an outside judge the model can run (held-out data, metric, tool), not the model's own judgement

test_cases.name: range_homepage
test_cases.input: I need to redesign my personal homepage and want to be more ambitious than a template refresh. I'm a freelance data engineer.
assertions: Suggests specialists or tools from outside web design (e.g. 3D, motion, storytelling)
Replaces noun 'homepage' with verbs or outcomes
Asks the model to do what each specialist does rather than role-play them

test_cases.name: meta_ambition_request
test_cases.input: How can I be more ambitious with AI on this research task? I'm comparing vector database latency for our search service and so far I've only asked for a summary of vendor docs.
assertions: Explains or applies Altitude, Depth, and/or Range
Provides concrete rewritten brief or next steps
References expert methods or cross-field approaches
